stem.text: Which diagram represents the effect of atmospheric humidity on the rate of transpiration?

A.alt: Graph of rate of transpiration against humidity, with a straight line starting at the origin.

B.alt: Graph of rate of transpiration against humidity, with a curve falling from the y-axis and levelling off.

C.alt: Graph of rate of transpiration against humidity, with a curve rising from the origin and levelling off.

D.alt: Graph of rate of transpiration against humidity, with a curve falling steeply from the y-axis and levelling off.
